title: How to Calculate the Michael Dickson Salary: Hourly to Annual with Casual Loading and Super
description: Convert the Michael Dickson salary from hourly to annual using 38-hour weeks. Includes casual loading, super, and tax. Based on Fair Work Ombudsman rates.
salarySummary: At the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour for 38 hours, the annual gross is $52,254.80. Casual loading adds 25%, and super is 12% on top.

faqs.q: How do I convert an hourly rate to an annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply the hourly rate by the number of hours worked per week, then by 52 weeks. For a full-time employee working 38 hours per week, the formula is: hourly rate × 38 × 52. This gives the gross annual pay before tax and super. The Fair Work Ombudsman's Pay and Conditions Tool [ can also calculate annualised figures for specific awards.

faqs.q: What is casual loading and how does it affect the Michael Dickson salary?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an extra payment of 25% on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for not receiving paid leave. For example, if the base rate is $26.44 per hour, the casual rate becomes $33.05 per hour. This loading is included in the hourly rate you enter into a calculator – you should not add it again. The Fair Work Ombudsman's payment for work page [ explains that casual employees must receive at least this minimum.

faqs.q: Is superannuation paid on top of the annual salary?
faqs.a: Yes, the super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings and is paid on top of your gross salary. For the 2026–27 year, the maximum contribution base is $270,830. So if your annual gross is $52,254.80, your employer would contribute an additional $6,270.58 to your super fund, subject to the cap. The Australian Taxation Office sets these rates.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Michael Dickson Salary

When you hear the term "Michael Dickson salary," it refers to a specific hourly rate that needs to be converted into annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures for budgeting, tax planning, and superannuation. While the web search results do not provide a precise figure for Michael Dickson, the Fair Work Ombudsman's resources and give you all the tools to calculate any hourly rate correctly. This article explains the conversion using the National Minimum Wage as an example, and covers casual loading, super, and tax.

### The Basic Conversion Formula

The standard formula to turn an hourly rate into annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**

For a full-time employee working 38 hours per week (the standard week under many awards), the calculation is:

- Hourly rate: $26.44 (National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026)
- Weekly pay: $26.44 × 38 = $1,004.90
- Annual gross: $1,004.90 × 52 = $52,254.80

This matches the on-site reference figures from the Fair Work Ombudsman. The fortnightly pay would be $1,004.90 × 2 = $2,009.80. Always use 38 hours unless your award or agreement specifies a different ordinary hours.

### Distinguishing Minimum Wage, Award Rates, and Casual Loading

The National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour applies to employees not covered by an award or agreement. However, most workers are covered by a specific award, such as the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award (SCHADS) or the Health Services Award. The Fair Work Ombudsman's pay guides list the minimum rates for each classification. For example, the SCHADS Award has changes from 1 December 2026 that increase rates by up to 15% for home care disability employees.

If you are a casual employee, you are entitled to a 25% loading on top of the base rate. This loading is already included in the casual rate shown in pay guides. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour. When using a calculator like [the timesheet](/) or [pay guides](/blog), you should enter the base hourly rate and then tick the casual loading checkbox – do not enter a rate that already includes the loading.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, and it is paid on top of your gross salary. Using the example above:

- Annual gross: $52,254.80
- Super contribution: $52,254.80 × 12% = $6,270.58

This is subject to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 for 2026–27. If your annual gross exceeds that, super is capped. The Australian Taxation Office administers these rules. Remember, super is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional cost to your employer.

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

For the 2026–27 financial year, the resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15%
- $45,001 – $135,000: 30%
- $135,001 – $190,000: 37%
- $190,001+: 45%

Plus the Medicare levy of 2% (based on 2025–26 single reduction thresholds). For a gross annual of $52,254.80, the tax would be approximately:

- Tax on first $18,200: $0
- Tax on $18,201 to $45,000: ($45,000 – $18,200) × 15% = $4,020
- Tax on $45,001 to $52,254.80: ($52,254.80 – $45,000) × 30% = $2,176.44
- Total tax: $6,196.44
- Medicare levy: $52,254.80 × 2% = $1,045.10
- Total deductions: $7,241.54
- Estimated take-home pay: $52,254.80 – $7,241.54 = $45,013.26

Use [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) for a more detailed estimate. Note that this does not include HELP repayments or the Medicare levy surcharge.

### Using the Fair Work Ombudsman's Tools

The Fair Work Ombudsman's Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT) provides up-to-date pay rates, penalties, and allowances for your specific award. The tool includes a disclaimer that it is accurate but may have a delay. Always cross-check with the official award. For historical rates, refer to the pay guides page.

### Why the Michael Dickson Salary Matters

Whether you are negotiating a job offer or checking your pay, understanding the conversion from hourly to annual is essential. The Michael Dickson salary – whatever the actual figure – can be broken down using the same principles. Start with your base hourly rate, confirm your award classification, add casual loading if applicable, and remember that super is on top. Use [reference tables](/data) for quick lookups, and consult [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) and [average pay](/topics/average-pay) for context.

### Final Notes

This estimate assumes a consistent 38-hour week with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax uses the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. Always seek professional advice for your specific situation.
